title: USD/CHF Weekly Outlook
summary: USD/CHF s rally from 0.7603 resumed by breaking through 0.8205 resistance last week. Though, it lost momentum after hitting 0.8262. Initial bias is turned neutral this week for consolidations first. Downside should be contained above 0.8156 resistance turned support. On the upside, above 0.8262 will target 100% projection of 0.7760 to 0.8205 from 0.7948 at 0.8393. [ ] The post USD/CHF Weekly Outlook appeared first on ActionForex .

title: Big Oil’s Production Keeps Soaring Despite Deep Spending Cuts
summary: Some of the world’s largest oil and gas companies have adopted a new modus operandi ever since the historic oil price crash of 2020 devastated energy companies, prioritizing returning more cash to shareholders while expansion plans have been put on the back burner.
